does: Scores for the AI a surface created over an area: for every AI-grid tile touched, the characters and items on it and the statuses the surface would give them.

evidence.says: walks tiles with eoc::AiGrid::ToTilePos and ToWorldPos, separates esv::Character and esv::Item, checks esv::SurfaceManager::CheckSurfaceTransformRequirement and esv::StatusMachine::HasActiveStatus; calls CalculateAiScoreSurfaceTile about 2000 times from one loop
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 2 places, CalculateAiScoreDestroyItem
